text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Autumn) had finally 
arrived. Once she overcame this, Mayano 
Top Gun would...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win here, build up my strength, 
and definitely... go to the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! Correct! I am indeed the 
one and only Tokai Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And so, a message for Mayano! It's from 
Hishi Ama!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"‘Mayano! Starting this spring, you're 
my――’ ...and so on and so forth, skipping 
the rest~."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine! The only thing that 
matters is the finish!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“I'm looking forward to racing you now 
that you've gotten stronger. Starting 
today—I'm your rival.”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, yeah! Well, I get it. Even I want 
to race against you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"So don't you dare lose! Win this, 
Mayano!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Take the lead and make everyone chase 
after you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, what's that, you telling me to run?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~? Could it be that Mayano is the 
type who can only chase from behind~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, there's no way that's true☆ Right, 
Trainer-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. So you two better not miss a single 
second of how Maya runs, okay?♪
